resolverBlockedTarget: Local or non-public target is blocked
resolverRedirectError: Redirect could not be followed safely
resolverHttpError: Website returned an unsuccessful HTTP status
resolverResponseTooLarge: Response exceeds the metadata size limit
bookmarkStaleTarget: The original insertion target is no longer available. Cancel and start again in the document.
bookmarkInsertionFailure: The Link Card could not be inserted. Cancel and check the original document.
embedXmlOnly: Only XML oEmbed discovery is available; XML is unsupported
embedInvalidResponse: oEmbed response is not a valid JSON object
embedUnsupportedType: Only link, photo and verified YouTube video are supported
embedInvalidPhoto: Photo URL or dimensions are invalid
embedUnsupportedContent: oEmbed endpoint did not return JSON content
embedInvalidVideo: YouTube source, provider or endpoint could not be verified
videoHint: Loading connects to YouTube. If playback is blocked, open the source link.
videoNarrow: The player needs at least 200 px of width. Widen the card or open the source above.
videoHostBlocked: This frontend does not support safe video playback. Open the YouTube source above, or use the browser desktop frontend.
migrationPreview: Review the counts, then confirm to replace these legacy blocks.
migrationEmpty: No confirmed legacy Link Cards to migrate.
migrationNotice: Uses stored titles/descriptions without metadata refresh. Confirming may download saved media URLs solely for local asset import. Optional failures and unsupported media are omitted. Categories may overlap; import counts in this preview are plans. Block IDs stay unchanged; Undo is per card within temporary history. Uploaded assets are not deleted on Undo or failure. Closing stops subsequent writes; a submitted update may finish.
migrationResult: Migration completed. Review the result below.
migrationError: Migration could not complete safely. No further updates will be started. Close and review before starting a new scan.
assetOmitted: Link Card inserted. Some optional images could not be imported and were omitted.
migrationFully: Fully migratable / migrated without media changes
migrationLocalPlan: Cards with planned local media import
embedNativePrivacy: YouTube embeds can connect to YouTube whenever SiYuan renders or reloads the block, before you press Play. Choose Bookmark Card for a passive card.
embedNativeUnavailable: Native YouTube embedding is unavailable in this frontend. Choose Bookmark Card instead.
youtubeMigrationPreview: Review the counts and confirm to convert supported historical HTML embeds to native SiYuan iframe blocks. Block identity is preserved.
youtubeMigrationEmpty: No supported legacy YouTube embeds to migrate.
youtubeMigrationNotice: Uses saved video identities without contacting YouTube or refreshing metadata. Preserves block IDs, document position, and original attributes. Normal Undo/Redo applies within SiYuan history. Native frames can contact YouTube when rendered or reloaded, before Play. Closing stops further updates; a submitted update may still finish.
faviconRepairNotice: This preview is local and read-only. Confirming contacts the existing source websites to discover and download favicons. Only missing or structurally unusable favicons are repaired; all other card data stays unchanged. Uploaded assets are not automatically deleted if an update fails or is undone.
faviconRepairPreview: Review the counts before allowing website requests and repairs.
faviconRepairResult: Favicon repair completed. Review the result below.
faviconRepairError: Favicon maintenance stopped. No further repairs will be attempted.
